entries.name: Falling Constellation
entries.description: Falling Constellation — a signature attack of the Heavenly Star physique.
entries.combatDescription: Tiny points of starlight awaken beneath [user]'s skin before streaking across the battlefield like meteors. Rather than exploding on impact, each star bends the surrounding space, forcing [target] to bear the crushing weight of an invisible constellation.

entries.name: Heaven's Zenith
entries.description: Heaven's Zenith — a signature attack of the Heavenly Star physique.
entries.combatDescription: Every awakened acupoint shines at once until [user] resembles a figure carved from the night sky. A pillar of celestial radiance descends from above, enveloping [target] as if the heavens themselves had acknowledged the attack.

entries.name: Worldroot Ascension
entries.description: Worldroot Ascension — a signature attack of the World Tree physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] presses a palm against the ground as enormous spectral roots erupt beneath the battlefield. The roots twist around [target], lifting them skyward before slamming them back into the earth.

entries.name: Verdant Genesis
entries.description: Verdant Genesis — a signature attack of the World Tree physique.
entries.combatDescription: Ancient branches of luminous jade spread outward behind [user], showering the battlefield with emerald leaves that restore allies while draining hostile spiritual energy from everything they touch.

entries.name: Unwritten Path
entries.description: Unwritten Path — a signature attack of the Chaos Meridian physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user]'s qi abruptly changes direction dozens of times in an instant, causing every movement to appear impossible. Each strike arrives from an angle that defies conventional cultivation principles.

entries.name: Primordial Convergence
entries.description: Primordial Convergence — a signature attack of the Chaos Meridian physique.
entries.combatDescription: The battlefield erupts as incompatible elemental currents spiral together without collapsing. A swirling sphere of chaotic creation expands toward [target], rewriting the terrain wherever it passes.

entries.name: Edge Between Breaths
entries.description: Edge Between Breaths — a signature attack of the Divine Sword physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] steps forward only once. No visible attack follows until [target] notices a razor-thin line appearing through armor, weapons, and earth alike, as though reality itself had been quietly divided.

entries.name: One Sword, One World
entries.description: One Sword, One World — a signature attack of the Divine Sword physique.
entries.combatDescription: Countless translucent blades appear around [user] before collapsing into a single invisible edge. The battlefield falls silent for a heartbeat before an overwhelming slash tears forward with absolute precision.

entries.name: Undying Ember
entries.description: Undying Ember — a signature attack of the Eternal Flame physique.
entries.combatDescription: Even after [user]'s flames appear to vanish, glowing embers remain suspended throughout the battlefield. At a silent command, every ember reignites simultaneously, surrounding [target] in a sea of white-gold fire.

entries.name: Dawn Without End
entries.description: Dawn Without End — a signature attack of the Eternal Flame physique.
entries.combatDescription: A radiant sun rises behind [user], yet it never reaches its zenith. Endless waves of immortal flame pour outward in rhythmic pulses, each brighter than the last until the battlefield resembles the first sunrise of creation.

entries.name: Tide Without Shore
entries.description: Tide Without Shore — a signature attack of the Primordial Sea physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] sweeps an arm outward as a colossal translucent wave rises behind them. Instead of crashing once, the tide continues flowing through the battlefield in relentless surges, steadily swallowing [target].

entries.name: Ocean Soul Invocation
entries.description: Ocean Soul Invocation — a signature attack of the Primordial Sea physique.
entries.combatDescription: Ancient whale songs echo through the air as spectral currents spiral around [user]. Every movement leaves behind flowing streams of spiritual water that converge upon [target].

entries.name: Heavenbreaker Pulse
entries.description: Heavenbreaker Pulse — a signature attack of the Heavenly Thunder physique.
entries.combatDescription: Lightning flashes beneath [user]'s skin before exploding outward in concentric rings. Every pulse grows stronger than the last until a final bolt descends directly upon [target].

entries.name: Ninefold Judgment
entries.description: Ninefold Judgment — a signature attack of the Heavenly Thunder physique.
entries.combatDescription: Nine pillars of heavenly lightning strike in sequence around [target], shrinking the circle of escape before the final bolt descends from directly overhead.

entries.name: Hundred Spirits Return Home
entries.description: Hundred Spirits Return Home — a signature attack of the Myriad Spirit physique.
entries.combatDescription: Luminous spirit lights emerge from every direction and circle [user] before rushing toward [target] like a silent celestial procession.

entries.name: Chorus Beyond Mortality
entries.description: Chorus Beyond Mortality — a signature attack of the Myriad Spirit physique.
entries.combatDescription: Invisible voices recite forgotten scriptures as overlapping spiritual echoes distort the battlefield, overwhelming [target]'s senses with ancient wisdom.

entries.name: Borrowed Breath of Heaven
entries.description: Borrowed Breath of Heaven — a signature attack of the Infinite Sky physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] inhales once. The surrounding winds abruptly fall silent before surging back toward [target] as a roaring invisible torrent.

entries.name: Horizon Unbound
entries.description: Horizon Unbound — a signature attack of the Infinite Sky physique.
entries.combatDescription: Brilliant streams of light trace across the sky as [user] crosses the battlefield in an instant, leaving only fading afterimages suspended in the air.

entries.name: One Thought Enlightens
entries.description: One Thought Enlightens — a signature attack of the Dao Heart physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] closes their eyes for a single heartbeat. When they open them, every movement becomes impossibly precise as though countless future possibilities have already been considered.

entries.name: The Dao Remains
entries.description: The Dao Remains — a signature attack of the Dao Heart physique.
entries.combatDescription: A vast circle of ancient Dao glyphs unfolds beneath [user]. As the symbols rotate, spiritual pressure settles over the battlefield, making every action by [target] feel unbearably heavy.

entries.name: Heavenly Ossification
entries.description: Heavenly Ossification — a signature attack of the Immortal Bone physique.
entries.combatDescription: Silver-white runes race across [user]'s skeleton before bursting through the skin as translucent bone armor. Every blow exchanged echoes like ancient temple bells.

entries.name: Eternal Skeleton Scripture
entries.description: Eternal Skeleton Scripture — a signature attack of the Immortal Bone physique.
entries.combatDescription: The inscriptions within [user]'s bones ignite simultaneously, releasing spectral calligraphy that circles [target] before collapsing inward with crushing spiritual force.

entries.name: Imperial Dragon Breath
entries.description: Imperial Dragon Breath — a signature attack of the Dragon Emperor physique.
entries.combatDescription: A deep breath draws mist from every direction before a roaring azure torrent erupts from [user], twisting into the shape of a celestial dragon that hunts [target].

entries.name: Sovereign Scale Domain
entries.description: Sovereign Scale Domain — a signature attack of the Dragon Emperor physique.
entries.combatDescription: Countless shimmering dragon scales materialize on the wind, orbiting [user] before converging into a spiraling cyclone that descends upon [target].

entries.name: Last Ember
entries.description: Last Ember — a signature attack of the Phoenix Rebirth physique.
entries.combatDescription: When [user] appears exhausted, a single ember ignites within their chest. Scarlet fire erupts outward in a sudden wave that catches [target] completely off guard.

entries.name: Crimson Rebirth
entries.description: Crimson Rebirth — a signature attack of the Phoenix Rebirth physique.
entries.combatDescription: Towering phoenix wings unfold behind [user] as golden flames consume wounds and become a blazing vortex that crashes toward [target].

entries.name: Heaven Supports Earth
entries.description: Heaven Supports Earth — a signature attack of the Heavenly Pillar physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] stamps the ground once. Stone pillars erupt in every direction, lifting the battlefield upward before collapsing around [target].

entries.name: Unyielding Axis
entries.description: Unyielding Axis — a signature attack of the Heavenly Pillar physique.
entries.combatDescription: Golden light climbs the length of [user]'s spine as an immense phantom pillar appears behind them. Every advancing step shakes the earth beneath [target].

entries.name: Spiral Nebula Circuit
entries.description: Spiral Nebula Circuit — a signature attack of the Cosmic Meridian physique.
entries.combatDescription: Constellations briefly illuminate beneath [user]'s skin before streams of radiant qi arc around the battlefield in graceful spirals, converging upon [target] from every direction.

entries.name: Galaxy Within
entries.description: Galaxy Within — a signature attack of the Cosmic Meridian physique.
entries.combatDescription: A miniature cosmos blooms behind [user], its revolving stars feeding torrents of celestial qi into their body before erupting outward in a brilliant wave that engulfs [target].

entries.name: Starsteel Tempering
entries.description: Starsteel Tempering — a signature attack of the Heavenly Forge physique.
entries.combatDescription: Molten runes spread across [user]'s body before cooling into brilliant silver patterns. Each movement showers sparks through the air, and every strike lands with the ringing force of a master smith's hammer.

entries.name: Heaven's Final Quench
entries.description: Heaven's Final Quench — a signature attack of the Heavenly Forge physique.
entries.combatDescription: White-gold flames engulf [user] before collapsing inward. The condensed heat is released in a single explosive palm that leaves molten fractures racing beneath [target]'s feet.

entries.name: Endless Tide
entries.description: Endless Tide — a signature attack of the Divine Ocean physique.
entries.combatDescription: A wall of azure water rises behind [user] before breaking into successive waves that never seem to diminish, relentlessly driving [target] backward.

entries.name: Leviathan's Breath
entries.description: Leviathan's Breath — a signature attack of the Divine Ocean physique.
entries.combatDescription: The sound of a distant sea beast echoes across the battlefield as translucent currents spiral around [target], crushing them beneath immense spiritual pressure.

entries.name: Twin Horizons
entries.description: Twin Horizons — a signature attack of the Yin-Yang Harmony physique.
entries.combatDescription: Black and white streams of qi orbit [user] before intertwining into a luminous spiral. Wherever the currents pass, they unravel hostile techniques before striking [target].

entries.name: Balance Beyond Heaven
entries.description: Balance Beyond Heaven — a signature attack of the Yin-Yang Harmony physique.
entries.combatDescription: A great taiji sigil unfolds beneath the battlefield, drawing opposing energies into perfect unity until a single harmonious pulse surges toward [target].

entries.name: Lotus Rain
entries.description: Lotus Rain — a signature attack of the Thousand Lotus physique.
entries.combatDescription: Thousands of glowing lotus petals drift gently through the air. The serene display suddenly transforms into a torrent of razor-edged petals that sweep across the battlefield toward [target].

entries.name: Bloom of Ten Thousand Spirits
entries.description: Bloom of Ten Thousand Spirits — a signature attack of the Thousand Lotus physique.
entries.combatDescription: Gigantic lotus blossoms open beneath [target], releasing waves of radiant spiritual light that expand outward in graceful circles before closing like celestial flowers.

entries.name: King's Footfall
entries.description: King's Footfall — a signature attack of the Mountain King physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] steps forward once. The ground ripples outward in expanding rings before towering stone ridges erupt beneath [target].

entries.name: Crown of the Peaks
entries.description: Crown of the Peaks — a signature attack of the Mountain King physique.
entries.combatDescription: A colossal mountain silhouette rises behind [user]. Every punch carries the crushing weight of a collapsing summit, shaking the battlefield with each impact.

entries.name: Breath That Stilled the Clouds
entries.description: Breath That Stilled the Clouds — a signature attack of the Heaven's Breath physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] inhales until the surrounding winds fall completely silent. With a single exhale, compressed heavenly currents explode outward, carving a clear path through everything before reaching [target].

entries.name: Heavenly Respiration Cycle
entries.description: Heavenly Respiration Cycle — a signature attack of the Heaven's Breath physique.
entries.combatDescription: A luminous mist circulates around [user] with every measured breath. Each cycle strengthens their aura before the gathered spiritual winds spiral toward [target].

entries.name: Seed of Creation
entries.description: Seed of Creation — a signature attack of the Genesis Core physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] places a palm upon the ground, causing a glowing seed to descend into the earth. Moments later immense crystalline roots burst upward beneath [target], reshaping the battlefield.

entries.name: Inner World Unfolding
entries.description: Inner World Unfolding — a signature attack of the Genesis Core physique.
entries.combatDescription: A vision of mountains, rivers, and forests briefly appears behind [user]. The phantom landscape collapses inward, releasing an overwhelming surge of primordial qi toward [target].

entries.name: River Through Heaven
entries.description: River Through Heaven — a signature attack of the Celestial Vein physique.
entries.combatDescription: Golden streams of spiritual energy race beneath [user]'s skin before erupting into radiant currents that weave around obstacles to strike [target].

entries.name: Celestial Pulse
entries.description: Celestial Pulse — a signature attack of the Celestial Vein physique.
entries.combatDescription: Every heartbeat sends concentric waves of luminous qi across the battlefield. The expanding rings grow brighter until they converge upon [target] in a brilliant flash.

entries.name: Bottomless Tide
entries.description: Bottomless Tide — a signature attack of the Abyssal Heart physique.
entries.combatDescription: Dark blue currents spread quietly across the ground before rising into towering walls that fold inward from every direction around [target].

entries.name: Silent Abyss
entries.description: Silent Abyss — a signature attack of the Abyssal Heart physique.
entries.combatDescription: The sounds of battle vanish as a sphere of tranquil darkness expands from [user]. Within its boundaries, every movement by [target] feels unbearably heavy, as though submerged beneath the deepest ocean.

entries.name: Imperial Edict
entries.description: Imperial Edict — a signature attack of the Heavenly Emperor physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] raises a single hand as radiant imperial seals appear throughout the sky. One by one they descend, each carrying overwhelming heavenly authority toward [target].

entries.name: Throne Above the Nine Heavens
entries.description: Throne Above the Nine Heavens — a signature attack of the Heavenly Emperor physique.
entries.combatDescription: A magnificent golden throne manifests behind [user]. As they step forward, invisible pressure spreads across the battlefield, forcing [target] to feel as though they stand before the ruler of the heavens themselves.

entries.name: Ancient World Awakens
entries.description: Ancient World Awakens — a signature attack of the Primordial Vessel physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] slams both palms together as weathered stone sigils emerge beneath their feet. The surrounding terrain rises into towering terraces that converge upon [target] from every direction.

entries.name: Primordial Reservoir
entries.description: Primordial Reservoir — a signature attack of the Primordial Vessel physique.
entries.combatDescription: A colossal phantom vessel appears behind [user], overflowing with luminous primordial qi that pours across the battlefield before crashing into [target].

entries.name: Reflection Beyond Form
entries.description: Reflection Beyond Form — a signature attack of the Heavenly Mirror physique.
entries.combatDescription: A crystal-clear mirror manifests behind [user], flawlessly echoing every movement. Each reflection becomes a delayed strike that converges upon [target] from impossible angles.

entries.name: Heavenly Reflection
entries.description: Heavenly Reflection — a signature attack of the Heavenly Mirror physique.
entries.combatDescription: Rippling mirrors spread across the battlefield like pools of still water. Every attack aimed at [user] fractures into shimmering reflections before a single perfected strike returns to [target].

entries.name: First Light of Dawn
entries.description: First Light — a signature attack of the Eternal Dawn physique.
entries.combatDescription: The horizon itself seems to brighten as golden rays spill outward from [user]. Every shadow recedes before a brilliant wave of dawn sweeps over [target].

entries.name: Sun Before Heaven
entries.description: Sun Before Heaven — a signature attack of the Eternal Dawn physique.
entries.combatDescription: A newborn sun rises behind [user], bathing the battlefield in warm crimson light before condensing into a blazing sphere that descends upon [target].

entries.name: The Mountain Remembers
entries.description: The Mountain Remembers — a signature attack of the Great Earth physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] places a hand upon the ground. Echoes of forgotten mountain ranges answer the call as massive stone ridges erupt beneath [target].

entries.name: Worldbearer's Stance
entries.description: Worldbearer's Stance — a signature attack of the Great Earth physique.
entries.combatDescription: A towering silhouette of living stone rises behind [user]. Each step sends tremors across the battlefield until every strike lands with the crushing inevitability of shifting tectonic plates.

entries.name: Fivefold Genesis
entries.description: Fivefold Genesis — a signature attack of the Heavenly Genesis physique.
entries.combatDescription: Five primordial currents spiral around [user], weaving together into a radiant wheel that sweeps across the battlefield, each revolution reshaping the terrain before colliding with [target].

entries.name: Breath of the New World
entries.description: Breath of the New World — a signature attack of the Heavenly Genesis physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] exhales a single breath infused with pristine primordial qi. Wherever it passes, the air shimmers with the illusion of a newborn world before its overwhelming force engulfs [target].

entries.name: Chaos Before Form
entries.description: Chaos Before Form — a signature attack of the Primordial Chaos physique.
entries.combatDescription: The surrounding elements abandon their natural order, spiraling into a colorless vortex around [user]. The storm expands with silent inevitability before collapsing upon [target].

entries.name: First Breath of Creation
entries.description: First Breath of Creation — a signature attack of the Primordial Chaos physique.
entries.combatDescription: A pulse of primordial light radiates from [user], briefly returning the battlefield to its formless origin before reality surges back into place around [target].

entries.name: Ten Thousand Laws Listen
entries.description: Ten Thousand Laws Listen — a signature attack of the Heavenly Dao Vessel physique.
entries.combatDescription: Ancient Dao glyphs illuminate the air around [user]. Each symbol drifts toward [target], quietly unraveling hostile techniques before disappearing.

entries.name: Mandate Without Words
entries.description: Mandate Without Words — a signature attack of the Heavenly Dao Vessel physique.
entries.combatDescription: Without moving a finger, [user]'s presence alone causes the surrounding qi to bow. A radiant wave of heavenly authority rolls forward, pressing down on [target] like an invisible decree.

entries.name: First Soul's Echo
entries.description: First Soul's Echo — a signature attack of the Genesis Spirit physique.
entries.combatDescription: A translucent spirit silhouette rises behind [user] before dissolving into countless streams of radiant essence that flow through and overwhelm [target].

entries.name: Origin Resonance
entries.description: Origin Resonance — a signature attack of the Genesis Spirit physique.
entries.combatDescription: Every nearby strand of spiritual qi vibrates in perfect harmony with [user], producing a wave of luminous energy that expands like ripples across a tranquil lake.

entries.name: Empty Horizon
entries.description: Empty Horizon — a signature attack of the Void Emperor physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] walks forward as though stepping between moments. The distance to [target] quietly disappears before a silent strike arrives from empty space.

entries.name: Throne Beyond Reality
entries.description: Throne Beyond Reality — a signature attack of the Void Emperor physique.
entries.combatDescription: A vast black throne materializes behind [user]. Everything nearby grows unnaturally still before invisible fractures spread through space around [target].

entries.name: Flame Before Dawn
entries.description: Flame Before Dawn — a signature attack of the Origin Flame physique.
entries.combatDescription: A pale white flame blooms from [user]'s chest and quietly spreads across the battlefield. It burns without smoke, shadow, or sound until it reaches [target].

entries.name: Everlasting Ember Crown
entries.description: Everlasting Ember Crown — a signature attack of the Origin Flame physique.
entries.combatDescription: A crown of immortal fire appears above [user]. Each drifting ember transforms into a blazing phoenix feather that rains upon [target].

entries.name: Galaxies Turn
entries.description: Galaxies Turn — a signature attack of the Infinite Star physique.
entries.combatDescription: Constellations rotate beneath [user]'s skin before arcs of starlight sweep through the battlefield, converging from every direction onto [target].

entries.name: Emperor of Countless Suns
entries.description: Emperor of Countless Suns — a signature attack of the Infinite Star physique.
entries.combatDescription: Thousands of brilliant stars gather into one radiant celestial sphere that descends with irresistible momentum.

entries.name: Heavenroot Canopy
entries.description: Heavenroot Canopy — a signature attack of the Eternal World Tree physique.
entries.combatDescription: Towering branches of emerald light unfold overhead as roots erupt beneath [target], joining sky and earth in a single crushing embrace.

entries.name: Leaves of Eternity
entries.description: Leaves of Eternity — a signature attack of the Eternal World Tree physique.
entries.combatDescription: Golden leaves drift gently through the battlefield before erupting into countless beams of life-infused light.

entries.name: Heart of Molten Stars
entries.description: Heart of Molten Stars — a signature attack of the Heavenly Forge Heart physique.
entries.combatDescription: Each heartbeat sends blazing rings across the battlefield until a final pulse detonates beneath [target].

entries.name: Divine Tempering
entries.description: Divine Tempering — a signature attack of the Heavenly Forge Heart physique.
entries.combatDescription: Molten celestial runes flow across [user]'s body before exploding outward as incandescent fragments.

entries.name: Expanding Firmament
entries.description: Expanding Firmament — a signature attack of the Cosmic Origin physique.
entries.combatDescription: Invisible waves spread outward from [user], causing the very sky to seem farther away as immense pressure bears down on [target].

entries.name: Birth of the Cosmos
entries.description: Birth of the Cosmos — a signature attack of the Cosmic Origin physique.
entries.combatDescription: A swirling nebula blossoms behind [user], releasing newborn stars that streak toward [target] like celestial comets.

entries.name: Heaven Commands
entries.description: Heaven Commands — a signature attack of the Absolute Sovereign physique.
entries.combatDescription: Golden imperial seals descend from the sky one after another, each carrying overwhelming authority toward [target].

entries.name: One Throne Above All
entries.description: One Throne Above All — a signature attack of the Absolute Sovereign physique.
entries.combatDescription: A magnificent imperial throne appears behind [user]. Every gaze, gesture, and step magnifies invisible pressure until [target] feels the weight of an entire heavenly dynasty.

entries.name: Before Existence
entries.description: Before Existence — a signature attack of the Origin Void physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] takes a single silent step. The space between [user] and [target] disappears without distortion, as if distance had never existed.

entries.name: Hollow Dominion
entries.description: Hollow Dominion — a signature attack of the Origin Void physique.
entries.combatDescription: Darkness spreads without light being extinguished, leaving [target] suspended in a realm where sound, qi, and direction lose meaning.

entries.name: Echoes of Ten Thousand Lives
entries.description: Echoes of Ten Thousand Lives — a signature attack of the Eternal Samsara physique.
entries.combatDescription: Ancient silhouettes briefly surround [user], each demonstrating a different forgotten martial art before their movements merge into one flawless strike.

entries.name: Wheel Without End
entries.description: Wheel Without End — a signature attack of the Eternal Samsara physique.
entries.combatDescription: A colossal wheel of luminous scripture slowly turns overhead. With every revolution, [target] feels as though countless lifetimes are pressing down upon them.

entries.name: Heaven-Shaking Roar
entries.description: Heaven-Shaking Roar — a signature attack of the Primordial Dragon Body physique.
entries.combatDescription: The roar itself becomes a visible shockwave, tearing clouds apart as it races toward [target].

entries.name: Sovereign Dragon Ascension
entries.description: Sovereign Dragon Ascension — a signature attack of the Primordial Dragon Body physique.
entries.combatDescription: An immense azure dragon coils around [user] before launching skyward and descending upon [target] with imperial authority.

entries.name: Ashes Await Tomorrow
entries.description: Ashes Await Tomorrow — a signature attack of the Eternal Phoenix Body physique.
entries.combatDescription: Scarlet feathers drift gently through the battlefield before erupting into a sea of silent white fire around [target].

entries.name: Immortal Dawn
entries.description: Immortal Dawn — a signature attack of the Eternal Phoenix Body physique.
entries.combatDescription: Towering phoenix wings unfold behind [user], filling the sky with crimson radiance before collapsing into a single incandescent pillar.

entries.name: Beyond the Distant Sky
entries.description: Beyond the Distant Sky — a signature attack of the Infinite Horizon physique.
entries.combatDescription: [user] vanishes into a whispering breeze and reappears beyond every obstacle separating them from [target].

entries.name: Endless Journey
entries.description: Endless Journey — a signature attack of the Infinite Horizon physique.
entries.combatDescription: The battlefield stretches impossibly wide as shimmering afterimages continue advancing from every horizon until they converge upon [target].

entries.name: Edict of Heaven
entries.description: Edict of Heaven — a signature attack of the Heavenly Mandate physique.
entries.combatDescription: Golden proclamations descend from the sky, each carrying overwhelming celestial authority toward [target].

entries.name: Crown of Destiny
entries.description: Crown of Destiny — a signature attack of the Heavenly Mandate physique.
entries.combatDescription: A radiant imperial crown appears above [user], releasing waves of spiritual pressure that compel the battlefield itself to acknowledge their sovereignty.

entries.name: Heaven Rests Upon Me
entries.description: Heaven Rests Upon Me — a signature attack of the World Pillar physique.
entries.combatDescription: An immense spectral pillar rises behind [user], anchoring the battlefield before crushing downward upon [target].

entries.name: Foundation Eternal
entries.description: Foundation Eternal — a signature attack of the World Pillar physique.
entries.combatDescription: Ancient stone sigils spread across the ground, rooting reality itself in place as spiritual force surges through [target].

entries.name: Pages Yet Unwritten
entries.description: Pages Yet Unwritten — a signature attack of the Celestial Oracle physique.
entries.combatDescription: Invisible pages turn around [user], each revealing another possible future before one path descends upon [target].

entries.name: Chronicle of Heaven
entries.description: Chronicle of Heaven — a signature attack of the Celestial Oracle physique.
entries.combatDescription: Ancient scrolls of light unfurl across the sky, their glowing script transforming into countless spiritual seals.

entries.name: First Sunrise
entries.description: First Sunrise — a signature attack of the Genesis Sun physique.
entries.combatDescription: Golden light spreads across the battlefield as though dawn itself had arrived centuries early.

entries.name: Solar Genesis
entries.description: Solar Genesis — a signature attack of the Genesis Sun physique.
entries.combatDescription: A newborn sun blossoms behind [user], releasing concentric waves of radiant fire that wash over [target].

entries.name: One Thought, Infinite Paths
entries.description: One Thought, Infinite Paths — a signature attack of the Boundless Dao physique.
entries.combatDescription: Countless Dao symbols bloom around [user], each representing a different truth before combining into a single overwhelming realization that crashes into [target].

entries.name: The Dao Has No End
entries.description: The Dao Has No End — a signature attack of the Boundless Dao physique.
entries.combatDescription: The heavens fill with rotating rings of luminous scripture. As the rings align, every current of qi bends toward [user] before surging outward in a wave that seems to carry the weight of the Great Dao itself.

entries.name: Mandate of All Laws
entries.description: Mandate of All Laws — a signature attack of the Heavenly Dao physique.
entries.combatDescription: Heavenly script pours from [user]'s body until the battlefield is filled with living Dao glyphs. Every hostile technique dissolves into pure qi before the countless symbols converge upon [target].

entries.name: Genesis of the Eleven Paths
entries.description: Genesis of the Eleven Paths — a signature attack of the Heavenly Dao physique.
entries.combatDescription: Mind, Spirit, Yin, Yang Eleven primordial currents spiral around [user], merging into a radiant wheel that briefly reveals creation's original harmony before engulfing [target].

entries.name: First Light
entries.description: First Light — a signature attack of the Origin physique.
entries.combatDescription: A single point of brilliance blooms in the darkness before expanding into a tide of newborn radiance that washes over [target].

entries.name: Creation's Dawn
entries.description: Creation's Dawn — a signature attack of the Origin physique.
entries.combatDescription: A horizon of golden light unfolds behind [user], and the battlefield trembles beneath the birth of a new age.

entries.name: Worldseed Bloom
entries.description: Worldseed Bloom — a signature attack of the Primordial Creation physique.
entries.combatDescription: A tiny seed of light falls from [user]'s palm. Before reaching the ground it blossoms into a phantom world whose roots entangle [target].

entries.name: Birth of Heaven and Earth
entries.description: Birth of Heaven and Earth — a signature attack of the Primordial Creation physique.
entries.combatDescription: The five primordial forces revolve together until a newborn world briefly manifests, collapsing into overwhelming power.

entries.name: Where Nothing Remains
entries.description: Where Nothing Remains — a signature attack of the Infinite Void physique.
entries.combatDescription: Silence spreads outward as the battlefield loses color and sound. [Target] finds themselves alone within a boundless emptiness.

entries.name: Emperor of Emptiness
entries.description: Emperor of Emptiness — a signature attack of the Infinite Void physique.
entries.combatDescription: A throne carved from the void appears behind [user], and invisible fractures ripple through reality toward [target].

entries.name: Twin Eternities
entries.description: Twin Eternities — a signature attack of the Absolute Yin-Yang physique.
entries.combatDescription: A black-and-white sphere forms between [user]'s hands before unfolding into an immense taiji that swallows the battlefield.

entries.name: Harmony Beyond Heaven
entries.description: Harmony Beyond Heaven — a signature attack of the Absolute Yin-Yang physique.
entries.combatDescription: Every opposing current of qi bends toward perfect balance, transforming conflict itself into overwhelming force.

entries.name: The World Within
entries.description: The World Within — a signature attack of the Genesis World physique.
entries.combatDescription: A miniature world unfolds behind [user], and every mountain, river, and forest answers their command against [target].

entries.name: Heaven Inside the Self
entries.description: Heaven Inside the Self — a signature attack of the Genesis World physique.
entries.combatDescription: The boundary between the inner world and reality dissolves, allowing primordial landscapes to pour across the battlefield.

entries.name: When Rivers Flow Backward
entries.description: When Rivers Flow Backward — a signature attack of the River of Time physique.
entries.combatDescription: The current of time briefly reverses around [target], causing shattered stone, fading flames, and scattered blades to retrace their paths.

entries.name: Unending Current
entries.description: Unending Current — a signature attack of the River of Time physique.
entries.combatDescription: A translucent river circles the battlefield, carrying countless possible futures before one inevitable ending crashes into [target].

entries.name: Ten Thousand Lifetimes
entries.description: Ten Thousand Lifetimes — a signature attack of the Soulforged Sinew physique.
entries.combatDescription: Countless former selves appear around [user], each performing a different ancient art before every strike converges as one.

entries.name: Wheel Beyond Death
entries.description: Wheel Beyond Death — a signature attack of the Soulforged Sinew physique.
entries.combatDescription: A colossal wheel of golden scripture turns overhead, and the weight of innumerable lives descends upon [target].

entries.name: Before the Sun Rose
entries.description: Before the Sun Rose — a signature attack of the First Flame physique.
entries.combatDescription: Colorless fire spreads quietly from [user]'s footsteps until the battlefield glows with impossible heat.

entries.name: Eternal Sunrise
entries.description: Eternal Sunrise — a signature attack of the First Flame physique.
entries.combatDescription: A newborn sun ascends behind [user], bathing heaven and earth in immortal flame before descending upon [target].

entries.name: Infinite Horizons Become One
entries.description: Infinite Horizons Become One — a signature attack of the Omniversal physique.
entries.combatDescription: Countless overlapping realities shimmer into existence around [user] before folding together into a single impossible moment that engulfs [target].

entries.name: Beyond All Beginnings
entries.description: Beyond All Beginnings — a signature attack of the Omniversal physique.
entries.combatDescription: Mind, Spirit, Yin, Yang Every elemental law, every spiritual current, and every fundamental principle converges upon [user]. For an instant the battlefield witnesses the totality of existence before all of creation surges toward [target].

entries.combatDescription: [user] gathers a mouth of cold shadow and brings it down upon [target]

entries.combatDescription: [user] winds shackles wound from grave-cold about the limbs of [target]

entries.name: Shadelash
entries.description: A raking blow that strips a guard away.
entries.combatDescription: [user] rakes a lash of living shadow across the guard of [target]

entries.name: Challenging Roar
entries.description: A bellow that dares anyone to look elsewhere.
entries.combatDescription: [user] bellows a challenge, daring all comers to face it

entries.name: Guardian Stance
entries.description: Plants itself over its allies and weathers what falls on them.
entries.combatDescription: [user] plants itself before its kin, weathering what comes

entries.name: Sheltering Circle
entries.description: Draws a standing circle over a wounded ally.
entries.combatDescription: [user] draws a shelter of light over [target]

entries.name: Mending Chant
entries.description: Chants a wounded ally back to its feet.
entries.combatDescription: [user] chants low, and [target] straightens

entries.name: Sublime Deathblade
entries.description: A blade that is heavier the closer its target already is to the end — up to twice as heavy below a fifth of their health.
entries.combatDescription: [user] does not strike at [target] so much as sign for them, and the blade follows the signature down

entries.name: Death's Last Bloom
entries.description: The art of a cultivator with nothing left: it strikes harder the worse their own wounds are, up to two and a half times below a fifth of their health.
entries.combatDescription: Everything [user] has left opens at once, white and enormous, and closes over [target]

entries.name: Death's Neglect
entries.description: Known, never cast. The first blow in a battle that would end the bearer does not: they are held at a single thread of life and nothing touches them for a turn.
entries.combatDescription: Death arrives for [user], reads the office they hold, and goes to find somebody else

entries.name: Crimson Fate Blade
entries.description: Half blood and half steel. Opens a wound that bleeds for two turns, and leaves the wielder's own blood up — attack raised 30% for three.
entries.combatDescription: [user] draws a line that is already red before the blade reaches it, and [target] opens along it

entries.name: Crimson Field Absorption
entries.description: Floods the ground with blood-qi for three turns: the cultivator heals for 35% of all damage they deal, while every foe heals for half as much and bleeds 20% harder.
entries.combatDescription: The ground under [user] darkens and begins to pull, and every wound in the field turns toward it

entries.name: Heaven Severing Blood
entries.description: A blow that opens every foe at once: three turns of deep bleeding, and half the time a severed voice that cannot shape a technique for a turn.
entries.combatDescription: [user] cuts once, across everything, and the sky itself seems to part along the line

entries.name: Crimson Blood Frenzy
entries.description: Known, never cast. The first time in a battle that anyone — the bearer or a foe — falls below half health, the blood wakes for five turns: attack and speed raised 30%, and every wound the bearer opens bleeds twice as hard.
entries.combatDescription: the blood wakes at the smell of it and does not much mind whose it was

entries.name: Thousand Fang Tithe
entries.description: Half earth and half water, and both of them carrying. Opens the wound and fills it, then takes the strength out of whatever is holding the wound shut.
entries.combatDescription: [user] opens [target] in a dozen small places, none of them the one that matters

entries.name: Sovereign's Draught
entries.description: Drinks the field. The cultivator heals from the harm they do for three turns; every foe is dosed and left unable to close what opens.
entries.combatDescription: [user] breathes out something heavy and green, and it goes looking

entries.name: Body of Myriad Poison
entries.description: Known, never cast. Everything this body touches is dosed — every strike, every art, every talisman loosed — and the venom deepens with each one.
entries.combatDescription: there is no clean way to be hit by [user]

entries.name: Radiant War Force
entries.description: Half light and half iron, across everything at once, and it leaves every foe with nothing to do for two turns but swing back. No guard, no mending, no art that is not a blow.
entries.combatDescription: [user] does not so much attack as declare the terms, and the field agrees to them

entries.name: Perfect War Body
entries.description: Attack and defense raised 35%, for two turns at full health and as many as five at a fifth of it. A guard raised when you are nearly down is the one keeping you alive.
entries.combatDescription: [user] stops bleeding on purpose, and stands the way a wall stands

entries.name: Eternal War Momentum
entries.description: Strips every attack, speed and affinity penalty and hands each one back as a bonus of the same kind, half again as strong. Worth exactly as much as the trouble it found you in.
entries.combatDescription: whatever was done to [user] is read once, carefully, and then returned with interest

entries.name: Momentum of the Eternal War
entries.description: Known, never cast. Every turn this body is still standing adds 5% attack and 5% defense, and none of it fades before the battle does.
entries.combatDescription: the war has been going on longer than [user] has, and it is winning

entries.name: Venom Bite
entries.description: A bite that leaves something behind, and leaves more of it every time.
entries.combatDescription: [user] sinks fangs into [target] and holds on a moment too long

entries.name: Rotting Maw
entries.description: Filth in the wound: it bleeds, and it will not close while anything of the beast is still in it.
entries.combatDescription: [user] tears at [target] with something that has never been clean

entries.name: Drinking Lash
entries.description: Takes, and keeps what it takes: the beast is mended by every wound it opens for three turns.
entries.combatDescription: something leaves [target] along the line of the blow, and does not come back

entries.name: Silencing Cry
entries.description: A sound that arrives inside the skull. A quarter of the time, no art can be shaped for a turn.
entries.combatDescription: [user] makes a noise [target] hears somewhere behind their own thoughts

entries.name: Rending Howl
entries.description: Opens everything at once, and makes every wound worse than it is.
entries.combatDescription: [user] throws its head back, and the sound goes through everyone at once

entries.name: Sovereign Grip
entries.description: Takes the choice away rather than the turn: for two turns there is nothing to do but fight.
entries.combatDescription: [user] closes the distance and the fight stops being optional

entries.name: Venomous Body
entries.description: Known, never cast. Everything this creature lands dose its target, and the dose deepens.
entries.combatDescription: there is no clean way to be hit by [user]

entries.name: Death Throes
entries.description: Known, never cast. The first blow that would finish this creature does not: it holds at a thread, and nothing touches it for a turn.
entries.combatDescription: [user] should be finished, and is visibly not

entries.name: Cornered Fury
entries.description: Known, never cast. Below two fifths of its health the creature stops defending itself and starts spending itself.
entries.combatDescription: [user] stops backing away

entries.name: Rising Wrath
entries.description: Known, never cast. Every turn this thing is still standing is 5% more attack, and none of it fades.
entries.combatDescription: whatever [user] is, it is not tiring

entries.name: Infinite Echo
entries.description: The next three attacks the cultivator makes sound twice, each repeating for a further 40% of its damage. The repeat is not mitigated again — it is a share of a blow that already met the defence it was going to meet.
entries.combatDescription: [user] strikes nothing, and the air keeps the shape of it

entries.name: Echo Resonance
entries.description: Everything aimed at the cultivator arrives alongside its own echo, a half-beat out, and the two cancel. No damage of any kind reaches them until their next turn is over.
entries.combatDescription: Something answers [user] a half-beat early, and the two sounds eat each other
